Introduction

Zenith is the fifteenth subunit of tripleS. It is the fourth unit of the msnz project, where the 24 members of tripleS are each split up into four 6-member subunits.

The first member and leader, HaYeon, was revealed on September 4, 2025. Over the following days, the group held a "Grand Gravity" to determine the next five members. The next member to be revealed was YeonJi, followed by JiWoo, YuBin, JooBin, and SooMin.
